topic: Jellyfish have no brain or heart
script: Jellyfish have no brain, no heart and no bones. Instead, they sense the world with a simple net of nerves spread through their body. Their bodies are about 95 percent water. Jellyfish have drifted through the oceans for more than 500 million years. That means they are older than dinosaurs, and even older than trees.
